subject: Re: Correction: pickup quote 45111 Essen to DUS on 2026-11-24
body:
Hi there,

Thanks for the correction! We can collect from your site in Essen and deliver to the air export warehouse at DUS Airport.

Our all-in price is 350.30 EUR, and the pickup time is 13 hours. The quote is valid until 22 Nov 2026 08:41 UTC.

Your offer reference is TRK-16836. No booking is needed for the pickup.

Best regards,
Domblick Kurierdienst

classification.reasoning: The trucker responds to the pickup quote request with an all-in price, pickup time, and validity.
